purpose: Provide one bounded AgentSwitchboard-mediated child-agent seam so parent agents do not require pairwise native configuration for every other agent.

architecture.parentResponsibility: Select a bounded role and supply an explicit packet; do not share the parent's entire conversation by default.
architecture.switchboardResponsibility: Resolve the managed child runtime, enforce repository/write bounds, launch the child, capture local evidence, and return a bounded result envelope.
architecture.childResponsibility: Execute only the supplied role packet inside the designated repository/worktree and return evidence; completion claims remain hypotheses until coordinator validation.
architecture.continuumBoundary: Continuum remains the higher-level workflow/prompt-packet owner. AgentSwitchboard owns executable resolution and child-process launch semantics.

piTransport.reason: A bounded one-shot subprocess is easier to validate and isolate than a persistent RPC session while still providing separate child context and JSON events.
piTransport.rpcUpgradeGate: Promote to persistent RPC only after framing, cancellation, session isolation, and result-envelope contracts have dedicated executable tests.

request.promptPacketRule: Prompt files should contain only the context necessary for the delegated role plus exact scope, proof, and return requirements.

launch.credentialRule: Provider credentials are inherited from the operator environment or Pi credential store; AgentSwitchboard never accepts, persists, or logs provider secrets in the request packet.
launch.projectTrustRule: Child invocation forces the untrusted project-resource path and disables project extensions/skills/templates; AGENTS/context governance may still load according to Pi's documented context-file behavior.

resultEnvelope.rawEventSensitivity: local-operational; may contain prompt/model transcript and must remain outside tracked repository authority

failurePolicy.timeout: terminate the child process tree and return timed-out without retrying automatically
failurePolicy.missingRuntime: route to Pi system bootstrap; never fall back to an arbitrary user-level pi executable
failurePolicy.missingAgentEnd: treat process exit as unproven even when exit code is zero
failurePolicy.providerOrModelFailure: return failure evidence to the coordinator; do not silently change provider/model

proofCeiling: This contract and adapter can prove bounded child-process invocation mechanics and repository/write guards. Until a live provider/model run is observed, it does not prove provider authentication, model quality, successful delegated work, parallel child execution, or repository delivery.
